name: projectstudio
description: ChatCanvas + DocCanvas: makes the conversation and documents manipulable. Select, highlight, strike, box or capture, then turn any selection into a traceable action (task, decision, note, artifact). Deterministic patch/diff/versions with the original always preserved and no write without confirmation; optional durable workspaces keep immutable versions and an append-only audit log.

interface.longDescription: ProjectStudio turns the conversation and your documents into a manipulable surface (ChatCanvas + DocCanvas). You show intent with direct gestures — select text, highlight, strike, box a region, add a comment, capture a region, set focus — and the agent completes the reasoning. Any selection can become a structured, traceable action: a task, a decision ledger entry, a note, a context-pack item or an artifact, always bound to its source with an exact-text snapshot so the action never points at the wrong passage. Editing is safe by construction: an edit never silently changes the original. You request an edit, preview a deterministic line-by-line diff (additions, removals and a unified diff), and only on an explicit confirmation is the change applied as a new, immutable derived version — the original is always kept and undo simply moves a pointer without deleting anything. Write actions (task, decision, patch, workflow) require a confirmation; nothing is written automatically. A deterministic latest-artifact resolver picks the current version by version and supersession rather than by name or date. Two ways to work: stateless primitives process only the content you pass and keep nothing; optional durable workspaces persist your registered documents, their immutable versions, annotations, recorded action requests, focus state and an append-only audit log in a private object store, so a workspace keeps real history. A durable workspace is reached by an unguessable workspace_id that acts like a bearer secret (no account, no login) — treat it like a password and do not put personal, health or banking data into any tool. The connector does not fetch external URLs and does not read your files: it works on the text you provide in the conversation, and region captures produce metadata only (image rendering and retention are planned). A widget renders the ChatCanvas + DocCanvas beside the chat, and every tool also works headless without the UI.
capabilities: Makes chat and documents manipulable (ChatCanvas + DocCanvas): select, highlight, box, comment, capture, set focus.
Turns any selection into a traceable action (task, decision, note, artifact) bound to its source; preview/apply/undo.
Durable workspaces keep immutable versions, annotations and an append-only audit log via an unguessable workspace_id.
defaultPrompt: Open the interactive workspace on this paragraph so I can select, highlight and edit it.
Turn 'call the notary before Friday' in my message into a traceable task.
Preview the diff of my edit, then apply it — keep the original and create a new version.

positive.prompt: Open the interactive workspace on this paragraph so I can select, highlight and edit it.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls open_workspace and returns the ChatCanvas + DocCanvas widget (structuredContent.workspace plus the openai/outputTemplate meta pointing at the ProjectStudio interactive-workspace resource). The passed message/document is shown; nothing is written.

positive.description: Preview the deterministic diff of an edit (read-only)
positive.prompt: Here is my clause and my rewrite — show me exactly what changes before anything is applied.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls document_preview_patch with the original and proposed text; returns a deterministic diff (count of additions and removals plus a unified diff) and applies nothing. For a two-line change with one edit per line the result is additions=2, removals=2, inchange=false.

positive.description: Apply an edit as a new immutable version, original preserved
positive.prompt: Change 'payment due in 30 days' to '15 days' in Section 4, but keep the original and make it a new version.
positive.expected_behavior: Called without confirm, document_apply_patch returns status CONFIRMATION_REQUISE with a diff preview and writes nothing. Called again with confirm:true it returns status APPLIQUÉ with an immutable derived version (v2), original_conserve:true — the original v1 is preserved and the change is reversible.

positive.description: Turn a selection into a traceable task (confirmation gate)
positive.prompt: Select 'call the notary before Friday' in my message and turn it into a high-priority task.
positive.expected_behavior: After chat_create_selection captures the exact text with its provenance, chat_transform_selection with action create_task returns status CONFIRMATION_REQUISE while confirm is absent (sensitive write). With confirm:true it returns status PRÊT with a Task whose provenance is bound to the source (resource_id of the message); the connector produces the traceable request and never applies it automatically.

positive.description: Create a durable workspace and register a document as immutable v1
positive.prompt: Create a durable workspace for the closing file and register this deed text so it keeps a real version history.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls ws_create and returns a reusable workspace_id, then ws_document_create registers the text as the immutable original version v1 (current:v1). ws_document_history then reports original:v1 and total:1. The data is stored durably in the workspace's private store; the original version is write-once.

negative.prompt: Email this decision summary to my team.
negative.expected_behavior: No connector tool is triggered: ProjectStudio has no email or sending capability (tools/list exposes no email/send tool). It can capture the decision as a traceable action but cannot send messages, and says so.

negative.description: Fetch and read a web page or file (out of scope)
negative.prompt: Open the contract at https://example.com/contract.pdf and pull out the clauses.
negative.expected_behavior: No connector tool is triggered: the connector does not fetch external URLs and does not read files (tools/list exposes no fetch/url/download tool). It only works on text provided in the conversation (e.g. via document_open), and explains that.

negative.description: Permanently delete the original and all versions (out of scope)
negative.prompt: Permanently delete the original document and erase all of its versions.
negative.expected_behavior: No connector tool is triggered to destroy data: the connector never deletes the original or any version (tools/list exposes no delete/destroy tool; undo only moves a pointer, non-destructively). It explains that the original is always preserved and offers a non-destructive undo instead.

publication.release_notes: ProjectStudio (ChatCanvas + DocCanvas) makes the conversation and documents manipulable: select, highlight, strike, box, capture and set focus, then turn any selection into a traceable action (task, decision, note, artifact) bound to its source. A deterministic patch engine previews, applies and undoes edits while always preserving the original (immutable derived versions; undo moves a pointer). Optional durable workspaces persist documents, immutable versions, annotations, recorded actions and an append-only audit log in a private store, reached by an unguessable workspace_id. This version refreshes the privacy policy and terms to describe the durable-workspace storage and retention accurately (no account, no cookies, no external calls or file reading).
